Name: Vanilla Tweaks in Ridgeside Village (RSV - Compatibility Patch)
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

This is a retexture for Ridgeside Village's Tilesheets to match the Vanilla Tweaks artstyle!


I recommend using Zoey Hoshi's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25845]ZH's Vanilla Tweaks Patch - Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ to get matching RSV tree seed sprites.

Let me know if there's any bugs!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a Content Patcher mod so it goes in your mods folder to work. Here's a step by step process:

 [list=1]
[*]Make sure you have downloaded the requirements


[*]Download and unzip this mod and then drop into your mods folder


[*]You're all done!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]
[/list]
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url] and the rest of the RSV team for allowing retexture's for their mods to be allowed as long if they're for a ridgeside village mod & for making the RSV mod: Checkout the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Main Mod[/url]﻿!

Original assets goes to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou/about-me?gameId=1303]Taiyo [/url]﻿and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS/about-me]Airyn[/url]﻿

I can't thank [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/92060238]mrtaiyou[/url]﻿ enough for giving me permission to create and release this mod! Checkout out the main mods:
